# `x4effective`

```text
usage: x4effective [-h] [--version] [--db DB]
                   {build,ls,show,attr,who-sets,diff-mod,dump,sql,coverage,find} ...

Browse the effective merged values of every X4 entity, with provenance.

positional arguments:
  {build,ls,show,attr,who-sets,diff-mod,dump,sql,coverage,find}
    build               (re)build the effective store
    ls                  list entities of a kind
    show                all props + provenance for one entity
    attr                one prop across all entities of a class
    who-sets            provenance chain for an entity['s prop]
    diff-mod            every value a mod wins
    dump                live effective XML for ANY vpath (incl. md/, aiscripts/)
    sql                 read-only SELECT against the store
    coverage            what this store DOES and does not index (so a negative can carry its
                        denominator)
    find                entities whose in-game NAME contains TEXT (resolves {page,id} to English)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --db DB               effective store to read or build (default: $X4_EFFECTIVE_DB, or derived
                        from $X4_MODS / $X4_REGISTRY)
```

## `x4effective build`

```text
usage: x4effective build [-h] [--reference REFERENCE] [--kinds KINDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reference REFERENCE
                        unpacked base+DLC tree to build from (default: the configured reference
                        tree)
  --kinds KINDS         comma-separated entity kinds to build (default: ware,job,ship,shipgroup,lo
                        adout,station,stationgroup,module,modulegroup,plan,basket,people,mapdatase
                        t,sound,icon,gfxeffect,roomgroup,room,character,region,faction,macro,compo
                        nent)
```

## `x4effective ls`

```text
usage: x4effective ls [-h] [--class KLASS] [--filter FILTER] [--modified-only] [--limit LIMIT]
                      kind

positional arguments:
  kind             entity kind as stored, e.g. ware, macro, job

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --class KLASS    only entities of this class (the store's class column)
  --filter FILTER  substring match on name
  --modified-only  only entities a MOD changed -- the entity, any of its attributes, or a removal
                   in its own file; base/DLC-only rows are hidden
  --limit LIMIT    rows to print; the total is still counted (default: 200)
```

## `x4effective show`

```text
usage: x4effective show [-h] kind name

positional arguments:
  kind        entity kind as stored, e.g. ware, macro, job
  name        entity name (its id)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `x4effective attr`

```text
usage: x4effective attr [-h] [--class KLASS] [--sort {num,name}] [--limit LIMIT] kind prop

positional arguments:
  kind               entity kind as stored, e.g. ware, macro, job
  prop               property key as the store spells it, e.g. hull.max (macro keys carry no
                     properties. prefix)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --class KLASS      only entities of this class (the store's class column)
  --sort {num,name}  order by numeric value or by entity name (default: name)
  --limit LIMIT      rows to print; the total is still counted (default: 200)
```

## `x4effective who-sets`

```text
usage: x4effective who-sets [-h] kind name [prop]

positional arguments:
  kind        entity kind as stored, e.g. ware, macro, job
  name        entity name (its id)
  prop        one property; omit it for the entity-level provenance chain

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `x4effective diff-mod`

```text
usage: x4effective diff-mod [-h] [--limit LIMIT] folder

positional arguments:
  folder         the mod's folder name, as it appears as a provenance origin

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --limit LIMIT  rows to print; the total is still counted (default: 500)
```

## `x4effective dump`

```text
usage: x4effective dump [-h] [--reference REFERENCE] [--chain] [--annotate] vpath

positional arguments:
  vpath                 path inside the game tree, e.g. libraries/wares.xml

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reference REFERENCE
                        unpacked base+DLC tree to build from (default: the configured reference
                        tree)
  --chain               also print the file-level source chain
  --annotate            mark every node an overlay changed with a comment naming the mod, op and
                        patch line (removals listed in a header); implies --chain. Records who WON
                        each node, not who introduced it (F64); after a whole-file replace no node
                        is annotated and the header names the replacing mod; no attribute history
                        is kept inside a replaced subtree (F338)
```

## `x4effective sql`

```text
usage: x4effective sql [-h] query

positional arguments:
  query       one read-only SELECT or WITH statement (anything else is refused)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `x4effective find`

```text
usage: x4effective find [-h] [--kind KIND] [--class KLASS] [--limit LIMIT] text

positional arguments:
  text           part of the name the player sees, e.g. 'M0' or 'omega' (case-insensitive)

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --kind KIND    entity kind to search (default: macro)
  --class KLASS  only entities of this class, e.g. ship_xl (the store's class column)
  --limit LIMIT  rows to print; the total is still counted (default: 50)
```
